_summary: Declares the Generic project pack: a small starting point for custom work that defines its own artifacts and checks.
name: Generic
summary: A starting point for work that is not software or a document. The user names the deliverable, and the Quality Contract declares the commands, inspections, or human checks that count as evidence.

artifacts.name: Deliverable
artifacts.description: The text or files the project produces, named by the user at start.

typical_stages: Define the deliverable and its checks

evidence.name: declared-command
evidence.description: A command the user declares in the Quality Contract exits successfully.

evidence.name: structured-inspection
evidence.description: A reviewer checks the deliverable against a written checklist and retains the result.

evidence.name: human-check
evidence.description: A person follows a written procedure, confirms the expected result, and records it.

review_lenses.name: Correctness and reliability
review_lenses.focus: The deliverable does what the accepted decisions say, and its claims hold up.

review_lenses.name: Security and privacy
review_lenses.focus: The deliverable exposes no credential, personal data, or private content it should not.

review_lenses.name: Accessibility and user experience
review_lenses.focus: The deliverable is readable and usable by its intended audience.

review_lenses.name: Maintainability, documentation, licensing, and release readiness
review_lenses.focus: The deliverable is organized, attributed, licensed correctly, and ready to hand off.

completion: Every required evidence item for the phase has a current record.
Both phase reviewers approved, or the user accepted a recorded reduced-assurance decision.
The plan revision reflects every accepted change and deferral.

tools.name: git
tools.purpose: Version history for the deliverable and the PeerFoil records.
